{{Quote|&hellip;Storm the battlefield with Tyth, god of rage. The Firstborn of Izax and Scyva leads us to victory against the profane outlanders. Raise your bloodied fist and cry triumph&hellip;|"The Awe of Tyth," part of a Zakuulan devotional text|<ref name="Text" />}}
'''Tyth''', the '''Firstborn''', was the warrior god and avatar of rage among the six primary [[Six Gods|Old Gods]], the [[Deity/Legends|deities]] worshiped by the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] prior to [[Tenebrae|Valkorion's]] ascension to Immortal [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. The first of the four children of [[Izax]] and [[Scyva]], Tyth was accompanied on the battlefield by his sister [[Aivela]], and Zakuulans believed that Tyth would lead them to victory against [[outlander]]s.<ref name="Text" /> Tyth's sigil was a bloody fist.<ref name="Exarch">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Exarch Malforia}}</ref>

==History==
===Iokath superweapon===
Tyth originated as an experimental [[Iokath]] wardroid, built by an ancient, but highly advanced people. He, along with his five brothers and sisters, were tested on several unsuspecting worlds, leading to over ten trillion casualties. One of the worlds tested, Zakuul, would eventually come to worship the machines as gods, naming Tyth the god of war and rage. Even to the years following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Tyth was still worshipped by many on Zakuul.

Later on, when Iokath erupted into civil war, one side used Tyth and his brethren against the opposition, but the mere act of unleashing the war droids resulted in the extinction of all life on the planet. Afterwards, Tyth and the other Old Gods fell into dormancy.

===Reawakening===
{{Main|War on Iokath}}
By the time the [[Eternal Alliance]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] waged [[War on Iokath|war]] for control of Iokath, Tyth was the first of the six war droids to reawaken, wielding a gargantuan [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]]. Tyth's true nature as a superweapon remained unknown to all parties until the individual known as [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] confronted Tyth. The God of Rage revealed to the Outlander that a close companion had lured all three factions to Iokath to start a galactic war. Eager to demonstrate his power, Tyth attacked the [[Eternal Fleet]], which retaliated and forced Tyth to retreat.

Later on, a strike team sent by the Outlander infiltrated the Valley of the Machine Gods, where they found the unprepared Tyth. The [[Scyva|Mother of Sorrows]] commanded him to sacrifice the strike team to fuel their awakening, only for the God of Rage to fall in battle. Afterwards, the Outlander was able to use his power module to control Tyth during the Battle for Iokath.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tyth-SWCT.png|thumb|right|Concept art of Tyth]]
Tyth is referenced several times during the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] expansion, before making an appearance in '''Game Update: 5.2: War for Iokath'''.

Tyth is the first boss in the Gods from the Machine operation, which 8 to 16 players can perform.
